name: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
description: Collective-defence alliance; Article 5 treats an attack on one member as an attack on all. Finland (2023) and Sweden (2024) are the newest members. Leaders agreed in 2025 to a 5% of GDP defence and security spending target by 2035.

name: European Union
description: Political and economic union of 27 states with a single market, customs union and (for 20 members) the euro. Candidates include Ukraine, Moldova, the Western Balkans, Georgia and Turkey.

name: Group of Seven
description: Forum of major advanced democracies coordinating on economics, sanctions and security. The EU participates as a non-enumerated member.

name: Group of Twenty
description: Premier forum for international economic cooperation, covering roughly 85% of world GDP. The EU and African Union are also members.

name: BRICS
description: Grouping of major emerging economies that expanded in 2024–25. Saudi Arabia was invited but has not formally confirmed membership. Promotes alternatives to Western-led financial institutions.

name: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
description: Eurasian security and political organisation led by China and Russia. Iran joined in 2023 and Belarus in 2024.

name: Collective Security Treaty Organization
description: Russian-led military alliance of post-Soviet states. Armenia froze its participation in 2024 after the alliance failed to support it against Azerbaijan.

name: Association of Southeast Asian Nations
description: Regional organisation of Southeast Asian states built on consensus and non-interference. Timor-Leste became the 11th member in October 2025.

name: OPEC+
description: OPEC's 12 members plus allied producers led by Russia, coordinating crude output to manage prices. Saudi Arabia and Russia are the dominant voices.

name: Gulf Cooperation Council
description: Political and economic union of the Arab Gulf monarchies.

name: Quadrilateral Security Dialogue
description: Informal strategic forum of Indo-Pacific democracies focused on maritime security, technology and supply chains. Not a treaty alliance.

name: AUKUS
description: Trilateral security partnership. Pillar I delivers nuclear-powered submarines to Australia; Pillar II covers advanced technologies such as AI, hypersonics and quantum.

name: Five Eyes
description: Signals-intelligence alliance rooted in the UKUSA Agreement — the most integrated intelligence partnership in the world.

name: Mercosur
description: South American customs union. Bolivia became a full member in 2024; Venezuela is suspended. A trade agreement with the EU was concluded in December 2024.

name: USMCA / CUSMA / T-MEC
description: North American free-trade agreement that replaced NAFTA. A formal joint review is due in 2026.

name: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership
description: High-standard Pacific trade pact. The UK joined in December 2024; China and Taiwan have applied.
